title: Head Over Heals Cottage Seaside, FL
meta_description: Head Over Heals is a newly renovated townhome on Ruskin Park in the heart of Seaside. Never before rented, this designer home has 3 king suites, bright living spaces, and covered porches with park views. A prime location in Seaside.
description_expanded: Description209 E Ruskin Place 3 Kings, 2 Twin XL bunks, Sleeps 10 A Newly Renovated Luxury Townhome in the Heart of SeasideWelcome to Head Over Heals, a completely reimagined luxury townhome overlooking Ruskin Park in the heart of Seaside, Florida. Newly renovated to the studs and never before offered as a vacation rental, this design-forward retreat features three spacious king suites, curated designer furnishings, and elevated finishes rarely found in Seaside townhomes. Ideally positioned along Ruskin Park in Seaside Proper, the home offers effortless walkability to the beach, town center, and Seaside’s iconic shops and restaurants.First Floor Arrival & Relaxed Lounge LivingGuests arrive through private rear parking for two vehicles before stepping into a welcoming first-floor living lounge. This relaxed space features a sofa, two club chairs, and a large mounted flat-screen TV, creating an easy gathering spot for movies or casual conversation. Just off the living room is a stylish wet bar with a coffee setup, ideal for entertaining or slow mornings before heading to the beach. Two oversized custom built-in bunk beds with reading lights and integrated storage provide a fun retreat for teens or children, while a nearby half bath adds convenience. Colorful modern artwork and bright designer furnishings bring personality and warmth to the space.First Floor King SuiteAlso located on the first floor is the first of three king suites. This serene bedroom includes a mounted Frame TV, closet storage, and a beautifully designed ensuite bath. The spa-style bathroom features dual vanities with backlit mirrors and a spacious walk-in shower with dual rain shower heads, creating a relaxing place to unwind after a day along the coast.Second Floor Grand King Primary SuiteThe second floor features an expansive king primary suite designed as a private retreat. A cozy sitting area with two club chairs sits beside large windows surrounded by charming shutters that can be opened to welcome natural light. The room also includes a large Frame TV and generous closet space. The spa-inspired ensuite bathroom offers a marble dual vanity with custom illuminated cabinetry, elegant gold sconces, and backlit mirrors. A deep soaking tub sits beside a glass-enclosed walk-in shower with multiple shower heads and a dramatic ceiling-mounted rain shower, creating a luxurious space to relax after sun-filled days in Seaside.Second Floor Parkside King Suite with BalconyAt the front of the home, the third king suite enjoys beautiful views over Ruskin Park. French doors open onto a covered balcony with two lounge rockers overlooking the park’s treetops—perfect for morning coffee or an evening nightcap. Inside, the suite features a mounted Frame TV and a spa-style bathroom with a marble vanity, backlit mirror, and glass-enclosed walk-in shower with a rain shower head and handheld wand. This suite also provides direct access to the home’s elevator, offering added convenience for guests. A laundry room is tucked discreetly into the hallway behind a stylish sliding barn door.Third Floor Light-Filled Living & Gathering SpacesThe third floor serves as the heart of the home and is designed as a bright, welcoming gathering space for family and friends. The main living room features a large comfortable sofa and four club chairs arranged for easy conversation and relaxation. Two sets of double doors open to a covered porch overlooking Ruskin Park, where modern rocking loungers provide a peaceful place to enjoy views from three floors above the park’s canopy.Open-Concept Kitchen & DiningAdjacent to the living room is the newly renovated open-concept kitchen and dining area. Custom cabinetry provides generous storage, while a four-burner electric cooktop, Keurig coffee maker, built-in microwave, and spacious pantry make preparing meals easy. The kitchen is accented by striking green marble walls that add a dramatic design element. The adjacent dining table comfortably seats six guests, while a second wet bar offers additional space for preparing cocktails or beach-day refreshments. A skylit half bath on this level adds convenience for entertaining.Elevated Outdoor Living in Ruskin PlaceOutdoor living continues just steps away on the home’s rear deck, perched above the charming streets of Ruskin Place. This spacious outdoor area features modern sofas and club chairs arranged for relaxed conversation, making it ideal for evening cocktails or dining al fresco. A Weber gas grill makes it easy to enjoy casual dinners after long beach days along Scenic Highway 30A.A Design-Forward Seaside EscapeFrom its thoughtfully curated coastal-modern interiors to its prime location overlooking Ruskin Park, Head Over Heals offers a truly distinctive stay in Seaside, Florida. With three luxurious king suites, inviting gathering spaces, and beautiful outdoor living areas, this newly renovated townhome is designed for travelers seeking comfort, style, and the effortless walkable lifestyle that makes Seaside so special.Whether you're strolling through Ruskin Park, exploring the nearby shops and restaurants, or relaxing in the home’s beautifully designed spaces, Head Over Heals is the kind of place guests fall for instantly—delivering an unforgettable coastal escape in Seaside, Florida. FEATURESSeaside private residential beach access at West Ruskin Pavilion352 yards (4-minute walk) to beach access; access to the largest private beaches on 30ACovered private parking for two vehicles in a carport with private drivewayAccess to 3 swimming pools, 5 clay tennis courts, 3 pickleball courts (court fees apply), and a fitness centerWelcome tote with two beach towels, a complimentary bottle of wine, and two complimentary rental bikes for pickup at the Seaside Transit AuthorityPersonalized service throughout your stayStarter amenities providedGolf cart policy: A golf cart is considered a car; golf carts are prohibited for non-homeowners visiting Seaside. Special circumstances and medical needs require a golf cart permitNo pets allowedInduction stove topElevator Gas grill 2 wet bars throughout the home
